<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;"><a name="ITEM_9A_CONTROLS_PROCEDURES"></a><font style="font-style:italic;"><a name="ITEM_9A_CONTROLS_PROCEDURES"></a>Controls and Procedures.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Conclusion Regarding the Effectiveness of Disclosure Controls and Procedures </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company maintains disclosure controls and procedures as defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (&#8220;Exchange Act&#8221;) that are designed to ensure that information required to be disclosed in its reports filed or submitted under the Exchange Act is processed, recorded, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the SEC&#8217;s rules and forms, and that such information is accumulated and communicated to the Company&#8217;s management, including the Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, as appropriate, to allow for timely decisions regarding required disclosure. In designing and evaluating the disclosure controls and procedures, management recognizes that any controls and procedures, no matter how well designed and operated, can provide only reasonable assurance of achieving the desired control objectives, and management is required to apply its judgment in evaluating the cost-benefit relationship of possible controls and procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As required by SEC Rule 13a-15(b), the Company carried out an evaluation, under the supervision and with the participation of management, including the Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, of the effectiveness of the design and operation of the Company&#8217;s disclosure controls and procedures as of the end of the period covered by this Annual Report. Based on this evaluation, the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer have concluded that as of December 31, 2018, the disclosure controls and procedures are effective to ensure that information required to be disclosed by the Company in the reports filed or submitted under the Exchange Act are (i) recorded, processed, summarized and reported, within the time periods specified in the SEC&#8217;s rules and forms and (ii) accumulated and communicated to management, including the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, as appropriate to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Management's Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our management is responsible for establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial reporting, as defined in Exchange Act Rule 13a-15(f).  Internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States, and include those policies and procedures that:</p>

<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:4.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.52%;white-space:nowrap">

<p style="margin-top:11pt;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:24.5pt;;text-indent:-24.5pt;;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Corporate Officer</p></td>
</tr>
</table></div>
<p style="margin-top:11pt;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company's corporate officers are appointed by the Board of Directors and serve at the Board's discretion.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mr. Klosk joined Cambrex in October 1992 and has served as President and Chief Executive Officer since May 2008.&nbsp;&nbsp;He also became a member of the Board of Directors in May 2008.&nbsp;&nbsp;Mr. Klosk joined the Company as Vice President, Administration.&nbsp;&nbsp;He was appointed Executive Vice President, Administration in October 1996 and was promoted to the position of Executive Vice President, Administration and Chief Operating Officer for the Cambrex Pharma and Biopharmaceutical Business Unit in October 2003.&nbsp;&nbsp;In January 2005, Mr. Klosk assumed direct responsibility for the leadership of the Biopharmaceutical Business Unit as Chief Operating Officer.&nbsp;&nbsp;In August 2006, Mr. Klosk assumed the responsibility of the Pharma business as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer &#8211; Biopharma &amp; Pharma and in February 2007 was appointed to Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer and President, Pharmaceutical Products and Services.&nbsp;&nbsp;From 1988 until he joined Cambrex, Mr. Klosk was Vice President, Administration and Corporate Secretary for The Genlyte Group, Inc.&nbsp;&nbsp;From 1985 to 1988, he was Vice President, Administration for Lightolier, Inc., a subsidiary of The Genlyte Group, Inc. Mr. Klosk currently serves on the Board of Directors of Caladrius Biosciences, Inc., a publicly traded cell therapy company.</p>
<p style="margin-top:11pt;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mr. Cavanagh joined Cambrex in January 2011 and has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer since that time.&nbsp;&nbsp;From 2007 to 2009 Mr. Cavanagh was employed with Lonza, which purchased Cambrex Bioproducts, as President of Lonza Bioscience. &nbsp;&nbsp;From 1999 to 2007, Mr. Cavanagh worked for Cambrex Bioproducts.&nbsp;&nbsp;During that time, Mr. Cavanaugh held several positions of increasing responsibility including President of Cambrex Bioproducts.&nbsp;&nbsp;Prior to joining Cambrex Bioproducts, Mr. Cavanagh held various management and engineering positions with FMC Corporation.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:11pt;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mr. Farrell joined Cambrex in September 2005 as Corporate Controller.&nbsp;&nbsp;He has served as Vice President and Corporate Controller since July 2007, except for a portion of 2008 when Mr. Farrell was employed by PDI, Inc. as Vice President and Corporate Controller/Interim Chief Financial Officer.&#160; From 1994 until 2005, he was with Ingersoll-Rand Company, most recently as Director, Accounting Policy, Procedures and External Reporting.&nbsp;&nbsp;Mr. Farrell was with Ernst &amp; Young from 1988 to 1994, most recently as Audit Manager.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:4.79%;font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Ms. Hanley joined Cambrex in April 2009 and has served as Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since February 2015.&nbsp;&nbsp;She previously served as Assistant General Counsel and Assistant Corporate Secretary, from January 2013 until February 2015.&nbsp;&nbsp;Ms. Hanley previously held the position of Senior Intellectual Property/Corporate Counsel and Assistant Secretary. Prior to joining Cambrex, Ms. Hanley worked at Alpharma Pharmaceuticals as Director of Intellectual Property and was an Associate with Lerner, David, Littenberg, Krumholtz &amp; Mentlik, LLP, an intellectual property law firm. </p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">84</a></p>

He previously</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> served as </font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer from January 2011 to Janu</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ary 2017, and </font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since February 2007.&nbsp;&nbsp;Mr. Sargen previously held the position of Vice President, Finance.&nbsp;&nbsp;Previously, he was with Exp@nets, Inc. from 1999 through 2002, serving in the roles of Executive Vice Presid</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ent, Finance/Chief Financial Officer and Vice President/Corporate Controller.&nbsp;&nbsp;From 1996 to 1998, he was with Fisher Scientific International&#8217;s Chemical Manufacturing Division, serving in the roles of Vice President, Finance and Controller.&nbsp;&nbsp;Mr. Sargen has</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> also held various positions in finance, accounting and audit with Merck &amp; Company, Inc., Heat and Control, Inc., and Deloitte &amp; Touche.</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mr. Sargen currently serves on the Board of Directors of </font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Avid Bioservices, Inc.</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, a publicly traded </font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">biologics contract </font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">development and manufacturing organization</font><font style="font-size:11pt;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">.</font></p>
